title: Senior Account Executive - Americas
description:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

This position is open only for candidates based in the US & LATAM

🎯 What You'll Do

The Americas is where Hopae’s next wave of growth gets built. The US, Brazil, Mexico and

Argentina are live on Hopae Connect, and demand is coming from three directions at once: IDV providers adding government eID coverage, eSignature platforms facing new compliance deadlines, and regulated industries that need to verify real people across borders.

As Senior Account Executive, Americas, you own that territory end to end. You are accountable to revenue, not activity.

• Own the full cycle. First conversation to signed contract: qualification, technical discovery, commercial structuring, negotiation, and close. No handoffs to hide behind.

• Sell across all three of our buyer types. IDV’s, eSignature providers, and medium to large regulated industry players. You will learn to move between a platform integration conversation and a bank compliance conversation in the same week.

• Sell the recurring motion, not just the one-time check. Our strongest accounts use eID verification for ongoing login and session assurance, not a single onboarding event. Building that story into every deal is a core part of the job.

• Work direct and through resellers. A meaningful share of Americas revenue arrives through resellers whose own customers are the real relying party. You will also sell directly to large platform companies that need ID verification in many countries. (banks, casinos, crypto, ride share, etc.)

• Partner with BDR and Marketing on pipeline. You will inherit a researched target list and a BDR to work with, and you are expected to self-source alongside it.

• Run a credible technical sale. Work directly with Engineering and Product on integration scoping, sandbox evaluations, and production testing, so deals close on substance rather

than enthusiasm.

• Keep the forecast honest. Clean HubSpot hygiene, real stage discipline, and a number you stand behind. We would rather hear bad news early than good news that does not land.

• Be the voice of the Americas internally. Which countries, rails and use cases you keep hearing about should shape what Hopae builds and where it goes next.

🧠 Who You Are

• Experience: 6 to 8 years in B2B SaaS or API and infrastructure sales, with at least 3 years carrying a full-cycle quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You have closed deals where legal, security and compliance all had a veto.

• Market: Background in identity, KYC and AML, payments, fintech infrastructure, or reg tech. You understand why verifying a person in Brazil is a different problem from verifying one in Denmark.

• Technical Credibility: Comfortable with API-first products. You can read documentation, run a discovery call with engineers in the room, and scope an integration without needing a solutions engineer on every call.

• Territory & Language: Based in the Americas, with real coverage experience across the US and Latin America. Fluent in English is required; Spanish and/or Portuguese are a significant advantage for the LatAm side of the territory, but not required.

• Commercial Range: Equally at home selling direct to an enterprise and selling through a reseller or platform partner, including deals where your customer’s customer is the one who actually needs the verification.

• How You Work: Outcome-driven and self-directed. You set your own targets based on quota, hold yourself to them, and operate well across time zones in an async, global team.

• Bonus: Experience with LatAm identity rails (INE, CPF, CNH, RENAPER), regulated-industry selling, or the eIDAS 2.0 and EUDI Wallet landscape.

⚡️ Fast Facts

  • 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors

  • 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library

  • 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs

  • 🔬 82 eID research projects completed

  • 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

🎁 Benefits & Culture

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-friendly work model

  • Real ownership from Day 1

  • High-impact, global product

  • Multicultural, respectful team

🧭 Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Intro Call (30 min) – Get to know Hopae

  2. Functional or Technical Interview (45 min) – Dive into your skills

  3. Culture Fit Conversation (45 min) – Collaboration & alignment

  4. Offer 🎉

Note: The process may vary slightly depending on the role.

title: Customer Support Specialist (m/w/d) – SaaS & digitale Produkte
description:
Über Cannaleo Digital

Wir gehören zu den führenden Softwareanbietern im Bereich Medizinal Cannabis. Über 400 Apotheken nutzen bereits unsere Lösungen und mehr als 3 Millionen Bestellungen wurden über unsere Systeme verarbeitet. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte für Apotheken, Ärzt:innen, Großhändler und weitere Partner und gestalten damit die digitale Zukunft der Medizinal-Cannabis-Versorgung. .

Deine Rolle

Du möchtest mehr als nur Tickets lösen? Du hast Spaß daran, technische Probleme zu verstehen, Lösungen zu finden und digitale Produkte gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln?

Als Customer Support Specialist (m/w/d) bei Cannaleo bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund:innen, Product und Development. Du unterstützt Apotheken bei der Nutzung unserer SaaS-Plattform, analysierst Probleme und bringst eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Produkte ein.


Bei uns verändert sich viel: Alle paar Wochen gibt es neue Features, Releases oder technische Anpassungen. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die gerne mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und auch bei Veränderungen lösungsorientiert bleiben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Customer Support: Unterstützung unserer Apotheken bei technischen und anwendungsbezogenen Fragen – per Ticket, E-Mail, Telefon und gelegentlich Videocall

  • Troubleshooting: Probleme analysieren, Fehler eingrenzen und relevante Informationen strukturiert aufbereiten

  • Lösungen entwickeln: Nicht nur Probleme weitergeben, sondern möglichst bereits einen eigenen Lösungsansatz mitbringen

  • Prozesse verbessern: Wiederkehrende Probleme erkennen, Verbesserungsvorschläge entwickeln und bei deren Umsetzung unterstützen

  • Dokumentation: Interne Dokumentationen, Workflows und Standards erstellen und weiterentwickeln

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Product, Development und anderen Teams

  • Produktnähe: Neue Features und Releases begleiten und perspektivisch Verantwortung für Produktbereiche oder Produktkategorien übernehmen

Was uns bei dir wichtig ist

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und wartest nicht auf die nächste Anweisung

  • Mitdenken: Du hinterfragst Prozesse und bringst eigene Verbesserungsideen ein

  • Resilienz: Auch bei hohem Aufkommen, Bugs oder kurzfristigen Änderungen bleibst du ruhig und lösungsorientiert

  • Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Spaß daran, neue Systeme, Produkte und technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen

  • Teamspirit: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Menschen und Teams zusammen

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich, empathisch und professionell erklären

  • Eigenständigkeit: Du arbeitest selbstständig, weißt aber auch, wann du Unterstützung brauchst

  • Problemlösung: Du möchtest verstehen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert – und nicht nur das Symptom beheben

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Customer Support, idealerweise für SaaS, digitale Plattformen oder erklärungsbedürftige Produkte

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools wie Excel/Google Sheets und Ticketsystemen (z. B. Zoho Desk, Zendesk)

  • Technisches Grundverständnis; Erfahrung mit CMS, Datenbanken oder SQL ist ein Plus

  • Gute analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

  • Noch wichtiger als perfekte Vorkenntnisse: Du bist neugierig, lernst schnell und hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Innovatives Umfeld: Wir entwickeln Softwarelösungen, die die digitale Healthcare- und Cannabis-Branche voranbringen.

  • Vielfältige Projekte: Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, spannende Herausforderungen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum statt Routine.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Offene Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Für deine Erholung und neue Energie.

  • Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Partnern.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deine Arbeitszeit flexibel und passend zu deinem Alltag.

  • Feedback & Entwicklung: Regelmäßige Gespräche und konkrete Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Strukturiertes People Onboarding: Ein persönlicher und gut organisierter Start mit klaren Abläufen und festen Ansprechpartnern.

  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Übernimm Verantwortung und bringe deine Ideen aktiv ein.

  • Digitale Healthcare-Lösungen: Gestalte gemeinsam mit uns innovative Produkte und Lösungen für die Healthcare-Branche.

Warum Cannaleo?

Bei Cannaleo arbeitest du in einem Umfeld, in dem du etwas bewegen kannst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Projekte und trägst direkt dazu bei, medizinisches Cannabis für mehr Menschen zugänglich zu machen. Du hast Lust auf ein wachsendes Unternehmen und willst komplexe Projekte mit Struktur und Ownership voranbringen? Dann bewirb dich bei uns.

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

  • Experience with Hubspot

Soft Skills

  • You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships

  • You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs

  • You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone

Why join CrowdSec?

  • You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup

  • Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community

  • You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline

  • We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Retail
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to retail organisations across France. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with retail, grocery, fashion, and e-commerce companies. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the retail sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to retail stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in merchandising and supply chain, store operations, e-commerce and marketing, and customer service. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with retail decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the retail sector. Navigate complex retail organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to retail procurement cycles, trading calendars and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse retail market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within merchandising and supply chain teams, store operations, e-commerce and marketing functions, and customer service. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for retail applications
  • Navigate complex retail stakeholder ecosystems including executives, business and operations leadership, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from retail users and conveying retail market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for retail
  • Continuously refine the retail sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within retail organisations and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and retail use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate retail organisational structures and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, business and operations leadership, and IT departments
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within retail procurement frameworks and policies
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various retail audiences, from operational and digital teams to senior executives
  • Deep understanding of retail buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the retail market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • Fluent in French and English
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for retail use

À propos du poste

En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive chez Anthropic, vous rejoindrez l'équipe fondatrice chargée de faire découvrir notre API de productivité IA de pointe et nos solutions SaaS aux entreprises du secteur de la distribution et du commerce en France. Vous favoriserez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre en concluant des contrats stratégiques avec des entreprises de la distribution, de la grande distribution alimentaire, de la mode et de l'e-commerce. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise de la vente consultative dans le secteur du retail pour accélérer la croissance du chiffre d'affaires. Vous nouerez aussi des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes du secteur et les aiderez à intégrer et à déployer l'IA, tout en leur faisant découvrir l'étendue de ses capacités dans le merchandising et la supply chain, l'exploitation des magasins, l'e-commerce et le marketing, et le service client. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez en continu notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement, afin qu'ils trouvent un écho auprès des instances décisionnelles du secteur du retail.

Le profil idéal a à cœur de développer de nouveaux segments de marché, de repérer les opportunités à fort potentiel et de mettre en œuvre les stratégies qui permettent de les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en contribuant au développement éthique de l'IA.

Responsabilités :

  • Remporter de nouveaux contrats et générer du chiffre d'affaires pour Anthropic dans le secteur du retail. Vous orienter au sein d'organisations complexes pour atteindre les personnes décisionnaires clés, leur présenter nos services et les aider à réussir avec Anthropic. Vous piloterez l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la première prise de contact à la signature.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux cycles d'achat, aux calendriers commerciaux et aux processus budgétaires du retail, afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser le paysage, les tendances et les dynamiques du marché du retail pour traduire les plans stratégiques en actions et campagnes commerciales ciblées.
  • Piloter l'expansion sur le marché en identifiant de nouveaux cas d'usage au sein des équipes merchandising et supply chain, de l'exploitation des magasins, des fonctions e-commerce et marketing, et du service client. Collaborer de manière transverse pour différencier nos offres destinées aux applications du retail.
  • Naviguer dans des écosystèmes complexes de parties prenantes (direction générale, directions métiers et opérations, DSI et services achats) afin de construire un consensus.
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route et aux fonctionnalités produit en recueillant les retours des équipes utilisatrices du secteur et en relayant les besoins du marché. Apporter des éclairages qui renforcent notre proposition de valeur pour le retail.
  • Affiner en continu la méthodologie de vente dédiée au retail en intégrant les enseignements dans des playbooks, des modèles et des bonnes pratiques. Identifier des améliorations de processus qui optimisent la productivité et la cohérence commerciales.

Ce poste pourrait vous correspondre si vous avez :

  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience en vente B2B (SaaS, solutions API ou technologies émergentes)
  • Une solide expérience de la gestion de cycles de vente complexes au sein d'entreprises du retail et de la conclusion de contrats stratégiques, fondée sur une compréhension fine des exigences techniques comme des cas d'usage du secteur
  • Une capacité avérée à naviguer dans les organisations et les processus d'achat du retail, en construisant un consensus entre des parties prenantes variées, dont la direction, les directions métiers et opérations et les DSI
  • Une vaste expérience de la négociation d'accords complexes dans le cadre des politiques et procédures d'achat du retail
  • Une expérience confirmée du dépassement des objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, grâce à une gestion efficace d'un pipeline et d'un processus de vente en constante évolution
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication et l'aisance nécessaire pour présenter devant des publics variés du retail, des équipes opérationnelles et digitales jusqu'aux membres de la direction
  • Une connaissance approfondie des cycles d'achat, des processus de décision et des principales problématiques du secteur du retail
  • Une approche stratégique et analytique du marché du retail, alliée à une exécution tactique et créative pour saisir les opportunités
  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais
  • Un intérêt marqué pour les systèmes d'IA avancés et leurs applications, voire une expérience dans ce domaine. Le développement sûr et éthique des systèmes d'IA de pointe pour les usages du retail vous tient particulièrement à cœur.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Pursuits, ANZ
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Melbourne / Sydney

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Account Executive to join our Strategic Pursuits team, managing a focused portfolio of highly strategic accounts across ANZ. This is a role for a leader who will not only drive Cloudflare’s most strategic and complex platform sales but also innovate new business models within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled strategic influence, a profound understanding of customer enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to proactively shape how Cloudflare integrates into and advances modern cloud operating models.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Bengaluru, India)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll help customers succeed with the Figma product suite, from individual designers to large enterprise teams. You’ll join an experienced, close-knit support team that cares about each other and about doing great work for customers. AI is changing how people design and build, and our products are changing with it. You’ll be among the first to see how customers use what we ship, you’ll learn directly from our Product and Engineering teams, and what you hear from customers will help shape what we build next.

This is a full-time role based in our Bengaluru office.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Resolve customer tickets in Zendesk, mostly by email, such as helping a designer get back into a locked account or sorting out who can view and edit a shared file
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across the Figma product suite, such as figuring out why a prototype isn’t behaving as expected or why a customer’s AI tool won’t connect to Figma
  • Review AI-generated output and credit usage to make fair, consistent calls, such as deciding whether a customer’s AI credit usage matches what they were charged and explaining the outcome clearly
  • Write clear bug reports and product feedback, such as documenting the steps to reproduce an issue affecting several customers so Engineering can prioritize a fix
  • Facilitate calls with customers when email isn’t enough, such as screen-sharing with an Org admin to walk them through their team’s setup
  • Stay current as our products evolve, such as joining a launch session with Product Managers and Engineers, then turning what you learned into a guide or macro for the team
  • Work from our Bengaluru office during a schedule that aligns with US business hours

title: Account Executive 4
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive 4 on our High Tech team!

About the job

This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across our Messaging, Voice and Email products. In this role, you will be directly responsible for expanding our messaging business with some of the largest and fastest growing mid-market and enterprise companies in the High Tech vertical. New Business Account Executives are experts in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio’s product offerings. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with product management, carrier relations, finance, and solutions engineering teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive new customer acquisition, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)
  • Own highly analytical and consultative sales cycles to win business in competitive vendor sourcing cycles with Twilio’s messaging (e.g. SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Google Business Messages, Account Security, etc.), voice and email solutions.
  • Work with customers across assigned verticals (Financial Services) to understand their business and technical requirements, and match them to the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform, designing a solution for their specific use cases.
  • Work with teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.
  • Be passionate about what you do, think outside the box, and use world-class interpersonal and communication skills to present complex contractual, technical, and financial details to prospects in a way that builds confidence and comfort in the proposed solution.
  • Balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects and deals at the same time.
  • Partner cross functionally with sales, services, product, and finance to develop long range territory strategies and sales plans.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio’s product and carrier relations teams.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the CPaaS industry - staying up to date on key industry initiatives and new capabilities - on behalf of your customers and the wider Twilio go-to-market organization.
  • Generate and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce.
  • Stay current with industry changes and collaborate with your team and peers to learn and share best practices

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Possess a total of 8 years of tech sales experience, with a minimum of 6 years in a closing role
  • Directly selling technical SaaS or CPaaS and experience solution selling and multi-threading
  • Experience outbound prospecting into new accounts and a strong “hunter” mentality for bringing in Mid-Market and Enterprise sized accounts
  • Technical solutions selling experience working with real customers and prospects, listening to them, and solving problems
  • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships
  • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value
  • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define process and build programs
  • Record of delivering market driven results, especially to scale and enterprise customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience

Desired:

  • Deep experience working with telecom companies, including CPAAS, SMS aggregators, carriers, or global communications platforms.
  • Domain expertise from a highly quantitative industry such as DevOps, Fintech, advertising optimization, investment banking, security or commodity trading especially in non-standard segments.
  • Software, SaaS, CPaas or PaaS selling experienc

Location

This role will be emote and located in the United States.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 20% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $110,160 - $137,700.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $116,280- $145,350.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $122,400 - $153,300. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 20th, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply.   • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.
  • High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums
  • Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries.
  • Have an inquisitive mind to understand how things work
  • Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

  • Understanding of Telecoms and VOIP including WebRTC and SIP

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Experience with a CRM and Microsoft Office

Nice to have

title: Account Executive, Nonprofit
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Nonprofit Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic partnerships with nonprofit organizations. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to nonprofit leaders, helping them embed and deploy AI to amplify their impact across program delivery, fundraising, research, and operations. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the nonprofit landscape.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptional salesperson with a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products in the nonprofit sector, you will help organizations amplify their social impact while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within nonprofit organizations. Find your way to the right people at prospective customers, educate them about LLMs, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to launch

  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities, partnerships, and campaigns

  • Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and use cases within nonprofit program departments, development offices, research centers, and administrative functions. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings and sustain a competitive edge

  • Navigate complex stakeholder ecosystems including executive directors, board members, program officers, IT departments, and procurement committees to build consensus and secure strategic deals

  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering customer feedback and conveying market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition and enhance the customer experience

  • Continuously refine the sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

  • Build strategic relationships with nonprofit technology platforms, consultants, and sector influencers to expand market reach and create partnership opportunities

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience prospecting and closing leads, driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach

  • Familiarity working within complex sales cycles, selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and securing strategic deals by understanding multifaceted requirements and crafting tailored solutions

  • Success as a strategic business advisor, deeply understanding customer needs and creating innovative solutions that align with their vision and help them succeed

  • Exposure to negotiating complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders

  • Demonstrated history of exceeding quota by effectively qualifying and advancing opportunities in a fast-paced work environment

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently and build connections across all customer levels, from ICs to C-level executives

  • A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player

  • Analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative follow-up to advance opportunities

  • Passion for emerging technologies like AI, with interest in ensuring they are developed safely and responsibly

  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing markets combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities

  • Interest in or passion for social impact and mission-driven work. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience selling to or working with nonprofit organizations, foundations, or government agencies

  • Understanding of nonprofit operations, including budget cycles, grant funding, and procurement processes

  • Familiarity with nonprofit technology ecosystems, including CRMs (Salesforce NPSP, Blackbaud), fundraising platforms, and program management tools

  • Active involvement in the nonprofit community through board service, volunteering, or prior employment

  • Experience navigating procurement frameworks with budget constraints and multiple approval layers

  • Track record of building strategic partnerships with foundations or corporate giving programs

  • Understanding of specific nonprofit verticals (healthcare, education, human services, environment, arts & culture)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$290,000—$380,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Account Executive, FedCiv
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

title: Support Engineer (APAC - Weekends)
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams.

You will:

  • Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions.

  • Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members.

  • Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here:

  • Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency.

  • Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing.

You are:

  • Experienced in customer support, with 3+ years of experience providing developer support to technical customers.

  • Proficient in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL). You feel comfortable with complex SQL queries. If you have a database administration experience, it’s a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

  • Skilled in using Linux/Unix operating systems and the command line.

  • Experienced working with GitHub Issues and Discussions.

  • Bonus points if you're familiar with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte and have some experience with Node.js.

  • Having a degree in Computer Science is a plus too.

Timezones & Logistics

  • It’s a full-time position permanently, with four 10-hour shifts covering weekends during APAC Hours: 00:00-10:00 UTC

  • We are primarily looking for someone in Southeast Asia or India time zones for this shift.

  • This position covers Friday → Monday based on the above UTC times, so this may vary slightly for your specific timezone.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Manufacturing Industries, Taiwan
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive, Industries – Manufacturing to lead Anthropic’s go-to-market in Taiwan from our Singapore hub. You will bring Claude to Taiwan’s leading high-tech manufacturers in semiconductors, electronics, and the AI hardware supply chain, helping them apply AI across engineering, operations, supply chain, and corporate functions. You will own the full sales cycle with C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, working with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, and Partnerships to shape solutions that fit the market. As one of Anthropic’s first commercial presences covering Taiwan, you will also help define our regional strategy and build the foundation for long-term growth, in a way that reflects Anthropic’s mission to ensure the world safely makes the transition through transformative AI.

Key responsibilities

  • Meet and exceed revenue targets by winning new enterprise accounts and expanding existing ones, while landing flagship references across Taiwan’s semiconductor, electronics, and broader manufacturing sectors
  • Build and execute a territory plan that reflects Taiwan’s manufacturing landscape, including its buying behavior, regulatory environment, and data residency expectations
  • Lead consultative sales with C-suite and senior technical leaders, positioning AI as a driver of business transformation
  • Translate Claude’s technical capabilities into clear business value for manufacturing use cases
  • Run technical discovery with engineering leaders and speak credibly about security, IP protection, and deployment options with customers whose designs and process data are their most sensitive assets
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, and Partnerships to design tailored solutions and support complex deals
  • Build co-sell motions with hyperscaler and system integrator partners, including joint customer engagements and marketplace procurement, to extend reach across the territory
  • Identify new use cases and feed customer and market insights back into the product roadmap
  • Represent Anthropic with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders in Taiwan, including conversations about the safe and responsible use of AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise sales, business development, or account management, including selling to semiconductor, electronics, or other manufacturing customers in Taiwan
  • Deep understanding of Taiwan’s high-tech manufacturing ecosystem, including how leading companies organize engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain functions, and where AI creates measurable value
  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
  • Existing commercial network among Taiwan-based enterprises
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English, with strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, early-stage market
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Singapore, with eligibility to work there and willingness to travel frequently to Taiwan
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS into manufacturing, semiconductor, electronics, or industrial sectors
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler, channel, or SI partners

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Saudi Arabia
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Named Account Executiveto join our Sales team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

Regional Focus: Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia

What You'll Do

  • Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.
  • Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.
  • Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.
  • Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.
  • Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.
  • Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.
  • Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.
  • Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • 8+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions into major and enterprise accounts across Saudi Arabia, particularly Oil & Gas in Eastern Province, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding targets.
  • Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).
  • Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.
  • Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.
  • Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).
  • Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.
  • Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.
  • Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.
  • Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.
  • Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.
  • Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).
  • Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.
  • Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.
  • Language Skills: English and Arabic

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

  • Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals
  • Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers
  • Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products
  • Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels

  • Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers, ideally selling into conglomerates.

  • Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion

  • Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis

  • Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly

The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Singapore market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$116,480—$131,040 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
